steps.zh: 装好 ffmpeg 和这个 CLI
steps.code: brew install ffmpeg · pip install ffsubsync

steps.en: Point it at the video and the mistimed subtitle file
steps.zh: 把它指向视频和对不齐的字幕文件

steps.en: Extracts audio and marks speech / no-speech in 10 ms windows on both timelines
steps.zh: 抽出音频，把音频和字幕两条时间线都切成 10 毫秒的「有无人说话」窗口

steps.en: FFT-searches every offset and framerate ratio, then rewrites the subtitle timings
steps.zh: 用 FFT 搜遍所有偏移与帧率比例，然后重写字幕时间戳

value.en: Subtitles land in sync from one command — no language model, no manual sync points
value.zh: 一条命令字幕就对上——不需要语言模型，也不用手动打同步点
